params.message:
Sign with key-1 through one module that also signs on a PKCS#11 token

scripts/key-1.mjs opens key-1 from a descriptor (abovebeyond-key-1.key.json) or,
without one, the legacy JWK file, and returns raw Ed25519 signatures. sign-post.mjs
signs through it under the successor DID; did-webvh.mjs shares its token calls,
reads key-1 from a token slot for replace-key, refuses to generate over a key, and
parses token public keys strictly.
